notes: Planned attempt; no printer start sent. Human selected ONE full prototype V2 rotor printed concurrently with the fit fixture overnight, before physical fit-trial acceptance; the other two rotors remain held. Six new objects include a single ring arm shared between fixture and rotor; the previously printed numbered ring I is reused only if intact. The blank cassette is a non-electrical mechanical prototype. Grey PLA on the right nozzle normal external spool. Four walls, 30% gyroid, 0.10 mm layers / 0.20 mm first layer, 8 mm outer brim and normal snug supports including above-bed supports. Actual support removal, fine-feature inspection, captive hardware fitting, lock return and full assembly remain physical checks. Hardware stock, cleanup, fit, strength and function remain unverified. Earlier three-part left/right preparations were superseded as the current target before any start.
